verdict.rationale: three.js ships extensive live examples (threejs.org/examples) and a docs site with API references, plus llms.txt/llms-full.txt machine-readable docs tailored for AI agents, indicating some agentic-friendly exploration support. However, examples are not directly runnable/editable inline within the API reference itself, docs pages are hash-routed rather than addressable per-page, and there's no interactive sandbox tied to each API entry. Missing for 10: inline runnable code editors embedded in API reference pages, per-page stable URLs for docs, and independent confirmation that AI agents can programmatically explore/execute examples via the reference.
